Dates must come from the article body, not a listing page: FAS listing pages mis-attribute dates. `time` is optional and Asia/Singapore — state it only when the source does; never invent one. Validated by checks/news-audit.mjs on every push.

items.title: Singapore's U15 Boys depart for the inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival in Baku
items.summary: FAS confirmed the 14-strong Under-15 Boys squad, coached by Ashraf Ariffin, departed for Baku, Azerbaijan on 21 October to compete in the first-ever FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival. Singapore sit in Group P with Guatemala, Honduras, Canada, Guinea and American Samoa, playing all five group matches between 24 and 26 October at the Hovsan Competition Complex. Two Spain-based players, Kyen Sasikumar and Edan McCulloch, are among the squad named.

items.title: PSG beat Barcelona 4-2 in Champions League Matchday 3, Barcelona's first loss of the season
items.summary: Paris Saint-Germain came from behind twice to beat Barcelona 4-2 at Parc des Princes, with goals from Doué, Lucas Hernandez, Vitinha and Fabian Ruiz either side of a Lamine Yamal equaliser. The result was Barcelona's first defeat of the 2026/27 season under Hansi Flick and extended PSG's unbeaten run in the competition. Elsewhere on Matchday 3, Manchester City beat AEK Athens 5-1 and Liverpool won 4-3 against Villarreal.

items.title: Gavin Lee names a 25-man Lions squad for the ASEAN Hyundai Cup 2026
items.summary: Head coach Gavin Lee confirmed the 25 players representing Singapore at the ASEAN Championship Hyundai Cup 2026, which runs from 24 July to 26 August. The Lions open their Group A campaign away to Cambodia in Phnom Penh on Friday 24 July, return home to face Timor-Leste on 27 July, then travel to defending champions Vietnam on 31 July.

items.title: Tickets released for Singapore's ASEAN Hyundai Cup home fixtures at Jalan Besar Stadium
items.summary: FAS put tickets for the Lions' home Group A fixture against Timor-Leste on sale at 11am, with tickets for the 7 August home fixture against Indonesia following on Wednesday 22 July, also at 11am. Both fixtures are at Jalan Besar Stadium.
